text:
sam_marketing: Quick heads-up — influencer partnership draft just landed. They want a short TikTok + X thread next Tue. Need disclosure wording, legal ok on product lines, and embargos? @legal_kate @oliver_social

oliver_social: Nice. Do we have final creative? If it's TikTok we'll need a 15s cut and 60s variant. I'll draft two caption options. Also want to confirm whether we allow them to show internal dashboard screens.

legal_kate: Two immediate legal points: (1) Paid partnership must include clear disclosure (e.g., #ad or "Paid partnership with Redwood Inference"). (2) No unapproved performance metrics in captions or on-screen. If they want to show dashboard screenshots we need a signed data-release and to blur any customer identifiers.

partner_relations: Partner says they plan a "product-first" demo clip but might include a speed line. They've asked for a one-sentence approved quote. They can hit Tue but need quote + disclosure language by EOD Fri.

jonathan_pr: For PR, avoid using influencer as first public channel for product features. Request they run captions by us 24h before post and ask for a short embargo window (we prefer them to go live with our blog). If they refuse embargo, we should still approve but adjust messaging to be high level.

press_ops: I'll hold press outreach until our blog is live. If influencer posts early and generates press, we'll respond with the official release and offer interviews.

sam_marketing: Draft quote suggestion: "We partnered with [creator] to showcase how Redwood Inference helps teams deliver low-latency experiences." Legal?

legal_kate: That quote is fine. Add disclosure note: include on-screen text and caption like "Paid partnership with Redwood Inference". If they insist on a numeric claim, require evidence and sign-off from research.

oliver_social: I'll produce two captions: short X/TikTok caption and a longer LinkedIn post. Will also request the raw video for a quick quality check.

ceo_anna: Happy to provide a short sign-off quote if needed. Keep it brief and non-technical.

sam_marketing: Actions: (1) Oliver draft captions by Thu EOD, (2) Legal provide disclosure snippet (Kate done), (3) Partner_relations get signed content release for any dashboard footage, (4) Jon/Press_ops hold outreach until blog. Partner asked for final quote by Friday, we'll deliver.

partner_relations: Confirmed — partner will hold creative until we supply quote and disclosure. Sending creative brief now.

jonathan_pr: Good. One more ask: get creator to add a pinned comment linking to our blog when it goes live. Makes tracking easier.

sam_marketing: Thanks team. I'll post the final one-liner here Fri AM and Oliver will prep captions. Closing for now. :rocket:
